_help: Hand-checked numbers win over scraped ones. Key = IPO slug as in docs/data/ipos.json. Fields: issue_price, lot_size, net_qib_shares (EX-anchor), qib_times, listing_price, mf_demand_shares, and valid_demand_shares = FINAL VALID QIB demand in shares from the registrar's Basis of Allotment, which makes the allotment exact. To add an IPO the scraper missed, also give name, open_date, close_date, listing_date.
